title: Morning or Afternoon: Which Boat Trip Time Is Better in Madeira?
description: A 10:00 boat trip in Madeira often means lighter wind and the sun behind you. A 14:00 trip frees your morning and brings warm light home. Here is how to pick.
heroAlt: Colourful fishing boats in Câmara de Lobos harbour seen from the sea in soft morning light
keywords: morning or afternoon boat trip Madeira
best time of day for a boat trip in Madeira

images.prompt: Around 10:30 on a summer morning, seen from the water just off Câmara de Lobos. The small harbour with its brightly painted wooden fishing boats in red, yellow, blue and white pulled up on the shore and moored in the bay, the old houses and the rocky headland behind, green hills above. The sun is behind the camera, lighting everything evenly. The bow rail of a white motor boat with grey cushions is just visible at the bottom edge. No people in close-up. Realistic photo, true colours, calm water.
